originalIntent: UN R13-H stability requirements and ISO 3888-2 double lane change. The mechanism is the vehicle exceeding available friction, so a "loss of control" with no lateral excursion is a normal manoeuvre on a slippery-looking road. Bands are pre-registered from published test protocols, not fitted to observed results.
title: Loss of control: the vehicle dynamics themselves must be the mechanism
